entries.title: rebuild the docs site's break game when the release train bumps the version
entries.body:
The break game on the docs site is committed with the compiler's --help
and --version written into it (docs/site/break/shell.mjs, its manifest,
and examples/break-web/help.ts, which game.wasm is compiled from), and
tests/run.js's break-web section fails when they are not the compiler's.
The release train bumped the version in package.json and src/branding.ts
but left the game saying the old one, so v0.40.0's tag failed its own CI
and nothing was published. The train now builds the compiler from the
bumped src/ with the last release's seed, checking its attestation, and
rebuilds the game before it commits the release pull request. The
committed game is regenerated for 0.40.0, so main passes again.
entries.author: Amrit Kahlon

entries.title: rebuild the docs site's break game for 0.40.0
entries.body: The release moved the compiler's version, so the committed shell and the game's help still answered nish 0.39.0 and break-web's --check failed on main. Rebuilt with node examples/break-web/build.mjs; only the version string in the help and the hashes that cover it change.
entries.author: Amrit Kahlon
